messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: The Crestor brand of rosuvastatin tablets is distributed by AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals LP, Wilmington, DE 19850, under license from Shionogi & Co., LTD., Osaka, Japan.
Generic versions are also manufactured by several other companies.
Ezallor Sprinkle (rosuvastatin) has been discontinued and is no longer available.
Triplet: ["Rosuvastatin", "has generic version manufactured by", "several other companies"]

The relation 'has generic version manufactured by' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug (generic) is produced or manufactured by the company or companies specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
B. 'has generic name': The subject drug is sold under or known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
C. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
